provenance.prompt: Purpose: four original compatible tabletop makeup storage looks on the fixed vanity support surface. Model a real closed .45 x .25 x .25m full-motion envelope in metres, +Y up and +Z forward, bottom-centre origin. Share an actual rear-biased closed base, structural cheeks and roof, two solid rails and a real open-top thick tray moving 0..0.09m along +Z. The actual tray bottom, walls, handle, cavity, rail contact and unobstructed shared top/drawer support patches must pass independent loaded-triangle checks across the full state range. Build genuinely different shallow tray, divided storage, thick bottomed brush cups and open case with real side handle holes. All rest mesh vertices are baked into resource space under identity groups. Use opaque solid-color materials, no textures, animations or external models, and at most 2500 triangles, 32 meshes and four materials per resource. Preserve deterministic exporter/readback and source/dependency identities. Design: Two real thick-walled open cups at X±.17,Z-.045. Each has a closed 6mm-thick floor, 35mm outer radius and 29mm inner radius. Left/right rims are at Y=.25/.22. Preserve shared open central top and the real lower sliding tray.
provenance.method: Original closed solid carrier, real rails, thick sliding tray and distinct upper storage geometry. Rest vertices baked into resource space. Actual deterministic GLTFLoader readback and independent full-path geometry admission.
limitations: Finite 32-segment cup contours with actual independent solid floors. Static upper cups, bounded lower slide.
